name: Primal Amulet // Primal Wellspring
clause: // {T}: Add one mana of any color. When that mana is spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, copy that spell and you may choose new targets for the copy.

needs.proposedSignature: { kind: 'self-has-counters'; counter: string; atLeast?: number }  (extend the existing condition; equivalently a new { kind: 'counters-on-source-ge'; counter: string; value: number })
needs.semantics: True when the source has at least `atLeast` counters of that kind on it, evaluated as the effect applies. Today `self-has-counters` is a name-only >= 1 test and no Condition accepts an Amount, so the very common 'Then if there are N or more <x> counters on it, ...' transform trigger cannot be written at all - any encoding flips the permanent on the first counter. Pairs with the existing removeCounters cost / a negative `counters` amount for the 'remove those counters' half.
needs.clause: Then if there are three or more landmark counters on it, remove those counters, transform ~, and create three Treasure tokens.

needs.proposedSignature: add-mana gains `tag?: 'self'` (mark the mana as produced by this permanent); trigger { on: 'mana-spent'; from: 'self'; filter: Filter }; and a `withManaFrom?: 'self'` field on { on: 'cast' }
needs.semantics: Record, per mana in a player's pool, the permanent that produced it, so 'Whenever you cast an <x> spell using mana produced by ~' and '{T}: Add one mana of any color. When that mana is spent to cast an <x> spell, ...' fire exactly once per qualifying spend. Without it these lines can only be written as unrestricted cast triggers, strictly stronger than the printed card.
needs.clause: Whenever you cast an artifact or creature spell using mana produced by ~, create a white Gnome Soldier artifact creature token ...
